research_lineage: FKP18-CB1 compact delayed-feedback two-feature relation learned on fixed known synthetic families, FKP18-CB2 4 public R7-provided scopes with changed law and selective repair
hypothesis: A source-blind numeric learner can discover WHICH TWO generic public binary features partition four causal relationships, instead of being handed R7 low 2 bits. Independent exhaustively fitted four-feature conventional Boolean comparator must receive identical public credit evidence. Claim only bounded feature-binding discovery, never novel operator invention or unique native superiority from a tie.

worlds.seeds: 82300..82315 inclusive, public synthetic only, 16 worlds, four fixed private source structures repeated four times
worlds.source_rule: Four mode-dependent two-feature Boolean laws. For each world hidden two gate bits g0,g1 and two content bits x,y selected from the public 38-feature basis. True action=(x XOR y) XOR int((2*x+y)==(2*g0+g1)). This produces 4 distinct mode-specific four-entry truth tables. Source hidden feature indices, source formula and alternative outcomes never enter a learner.
worlds.randomness: random.Random(seed) for public 8×uint4 states and binary actions; random.Random(seed+1000) for 128 per-world unseen test states and public predecessor actions. No postscore world selection.
worlds.public_tape: 515 continuous interleaved public rows per world, 3 warmup rows and 512 earned-delayed feedback events, reward at t from actual action t-2, all public history continuous max16
worlds.train_action_selection: seeded common independent binary public intervention schedule rather than candidate-chosen exploration, exact same tape for both strong learners and negatives
worlds.eval: 128 unseen contexts from new public seed; action predicted before receiving truth outcome; source-owner scorer only compares actual binary action to hidden target; no eval feedback to learners
worlds.consequential_limit: one-step action-conditioned synthetic earned reward; not native multi-step closed-loop goal planning, no context-independent unseen operators, not private scientific world
worlds.protected_exclusions: never use original FKP17 DEV 978500..978531, TRANSFER 978600..978663, FKP18 independent private held source or any consumed original science

representation.public_basis: 38 binary features from 8×uint4 public state bits and three bits each of previous and older public actions, same CB1 encoding; do not provide correct source feature locations to candidate
representation.candidate: DIRECT_CONTRADICTION_GATE: stage 1 fit all 703 two-feature four-bin truth tables from delayed earned evidence and select highest training accuracy (lexicographic ties). Only if global fit <0.90, search pairs of other generic features as possible two-bit context gates; for each, construct 16-bin empirical majority truth table jointly over the discovered base pair and candidate gate pair; require all 16 bins >=4 observed, select best fit then lexicographic pair. Serialize four discovered feature indices and 16-bit truth table plus custody. No source import.
representation.strong_conventional: EXACT_FOUR_VARIABLE_BOOLEAN: independent exhaustive search over every unordered four-feature subset C(38,4)=73,815; fit unconstrained 16-bin Boolean truth table from same 512 earned delayed labels. Require all 16 bins >=4, choose highest accuracy and lexicographic tie. This comparator has AT LEAST same representational capacity and source data as candidate.
negative_controls: NO_GATE best learned two-feature four-bin truth table using all 512 examples, no contextual partition
THREE_FEATURE exhaustive 8-bin Boolean function over any three generic public features
WRONG_DELAY use present public state/predecessor bits with the earned credit label for t-2 (do not silently reassign source rewards), require clear negative score or failure classification
representation.capacity: 512×6=3072 bytes transient credited sample buffer max; finalized persisted candidate feature indices 4 bytes, 2-byte truth table, credited count, SHA256 evidence digest and SHA256 integrity; <=128 byte checkpoint, no donor activations, no gradients, no API.
representation.time_budget: Local CPU only; record candidate, strong control, negative fit/inference wall costs; no matched whole-process speed claim unless measured on same runtime; no extra sourced outcomes after thresholds/results
representation.bootstrap: 1,000 world-cluster resamples seed 82360; paired equal-informed candidate-minus-strong control accuracy; 16 primary clusters

prespecified_gates.engineering: exact source/control/candidate Git blob identity and focused tests PASS before original score, strict public schema/atomic invalid rejection, deterministic cold snapshot and checksum rejection, bounded model capacity and no protected seed import
prespecified_gates.evidence: all 16 public worlds with 512 earned credits and 128 prospective source-owner-scored new contexts; retain per-world accuracy, learned features, four-bin and sixteen-bin tables, IDs, action tape SHA
prespecified_gates.gate_discovery: candidate identifies the source-private gate pair (unordered, not disclosed to learner) in >=12/16 worlds and discovers >=12/16 source content pairs
prespecified_gates.earned_generalization: candidate overall unseen-context accuracy >=0.95; conventional 4feature >=0.95; no-gate <=0.85; three-feature <=0.95
prespecified_gates.strong_superiority: candidate accuracy minus conventional accuracy >=+0.02 and paired world bootstrap lower95 >+0.01; otherwise NO_GO_UNIQUE_SUBSTRATE, never scientific promotion
prespecified_gates.capacity: serialized candidate checkpoint <=128 bytes and exact readback, limits enforced; actual Python RSS and whole-process cost clearly separate
prespecified_gates.stop: Never retune candidate, source families, tests or thresholds after seeing primary result; preserve negative/null as measured, no new workflow, PR, controller or native change.
